Interface BaseView

All Known Subinterfaces:
CartView, CustomerView, EmployeeView, MainView, ProductView, TransactionView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface BaseView
Base interface for view components in the application. Defines common user interaction methods for displaying messages and gathering various types of user input. Implementations of this interface provide the user interface layer for the application, handling all user interactions.
